steps.title: Control Plane Preflight
steps.summary: 18/18 stack checks pass through the Rust gateway.
steps.operatorLine: Show the Console, gateway SPA fallback, API readiness, metrics, MinIO, and MLflow as one product surface.
transcript: Rust gateway serves the Console and SPA fallback.
Gateway rejects missing API keys and missing scopes before work starts.
Evaluation summary, VTON artifacts, metrics, MinIO, Grafana, and MLflow are reachable.

steps.title: Usage Quota Admission
steps.summary: Native quota ledger admits a user request and records remaining plan capacity.
steps.operatorLine: Open the quota step before any generation to prove user-level usage is controlled.
transcript: The ledger hashes the user and evaluates daily request and token dimensions.
Allowed traffic carries remaining capacity into the response contract.
The same quota state can back chargeback, budget alerts, and tenant throttling.

steps.title: Bad Model Gate
steps.summary: A seeded unsafe VTON candidate is blocked before champion promotion.
steps.operatorLine: Run the professor acceptance path and show the failed candidate as a successful safety outcome.
transcript: The bad candidate is unsigned and contains critical vulnerabilities.
Policy returns a non-approval decision instead of mutating the release lane.
The native Go acceptance harness records this as a passing professor-demo check.

steps.title: LLM Optimization Frontier
steps.summary: 4-bit LLM is recommended from a real Pareto sweep while the carbon gate remains green.
steps.operatorLine: Use the Pareto panel to show production tradeoffs across quality, latency, VRAM, and energy.
transcript: The real sweep ranks fp16-style, 8-bit, and 4-bit variants.
The 8-bit variant is dominated because it is slower and fails the SLO.
The recommendation chooses the smallest VRAM point on the passing Pareto frontier.

steps.title: VTON Quality Gallery
steps.summary: Two VTON outputs are compared with seeded images and metric-backed winner selection.
steps.operatorLine: Switch to VTON quality to inspect generated artifacts, failure labels, and winner evidence.
transcript: The standard run wins both garment-preservation proxy and structural-similarity selection.
The lower wide run remains visible with failure labels for audit discussion.
The gallery stays available offline because images and JSON reports are local artifacts.

steps.title: Promotion Lineage
steps.summary: Champion promotion is backed by signed model provenance and a reproducible release record.
steps.operatorLine: Move from model quality to release trust: signed artifacts, SLSA provenance, and promotion decision.
transcript: The release candidate carries local DSSE digest signing evidence.
SLSA v1 provenance is verified before champion promotion.
The promotion decision is recorded as an artifact instead of being an oral claim.

steps.title: Rollback And Governance
steps.summary: A rollback record restores the previous champion and governance mapping remains complete.
steps.operatorLine: Close with recovery and audit posture: rollback evidence plus NIST and OWASP coverage.
transcript: Rollback restores the previous VTON champion after chaos burn-rate triggers.
Governance maps every required NIST AI RMF function and OWASP LLM Top 10 ID.
This step completes the offline professor walkthrough without requiring live GPU or network access.
